sentences.text: 2 16-05-2014 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 341, 323, 353, 427, 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code and 31, 62, 63 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.

The petitioner's prayer made under Section 438 Cr.P.C. was turned down on 24.04.2013 passed in A.B.P. No. 5661 of 2012 by Special Judge, Food Safety Act, Patna, and after playing with the law for substantial period this application has been filed only on 19.03.2014.

entities.text: Special Judge, Food Safety Act, Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The act of the petitioner itself disentitles him for the privilege sought.

Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the abovenamed petitioner, in connection with Ram Krishna Nagar P.S. Case No.
127 of 2012 (G.R. No. 5070 of 2012) pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Ist Class,
Patna, is hereby refused in spite of the submission that some of the similarly situated co-accused persons have already been granted the privilege on 10.12.2013 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 20656 of 2013.
However, in the event the petitioner surrender before the court below within a fortnight seeking regular bail, his prayer shall be considered on its own merit.

Praveen-II/- (Akhilesh Chandra, J)
